digest.component_or_area: code-review impact model and pass-2 verification
propositions: a2: Classify unversioned_published_contract_break as SERIOUS only when a public API removal lacks a version/deprecation signal (major version bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry); managed removals return FALSE and receive no boost.

proposal-3: Add removed_public_symbol and version_signal_present booleans to CodeSeverityAttrs; detect removal of exported public symbols via __all__/re-export/CLI/MCP (keyed on EXPORT, not caller); apply deterministic serious-tier boost (0.9 x 0.8 = 0.72) only when both removed_public_symbol=TRUE and version_signal_present=FALSE.
a1 residue fix: Correct stale 'churn 0 => freq_mult 0.5' comment in workflow_ops.py; amplify-only reshape and SERIOUS-tier non-dampening already landed in code-v4.
Bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION from code-v4 to code-v5 in sidecar.py to segment sidecars by impact semantics version.
Reproduce citric-preregal-ladybird (removed public API scored 0.30 vs 0.60 threshold) end-to-end; verify impact >= 0.60 through real packaged routing with removal detected and version signal absent.

Add version-signal gating to both pass-2 surfaces (CodeSeverityAttrs field description and code-review-verify.md prompt bullet); add removed-public-symbol sub-question explicitly keyed on public-API reachability, not caller presence.
